name: ForestFloor
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.281

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven forest_leaves_04 (2x2, self-blended with a quarter-turned copy) with forest_leaves_02 (moss, sticks, leaves; non-commensurate scale, relief halved) and patches of forrest_ground_03 (pine needle mat); every layer has its large-scale brightness drift removed so no band survives at 4x4; desaturated and darkened for shade
known_weaknesses: no cones; moss is sparse and olive rather than deep green
